    # clause 1: (NOT x0 OR x1 OR NOT x3) -> AND condition: x0 AND (NOT x1) AND x3
    indices = [0, 1, 3]        # variables in order
    negated = [False, True, False]  # x1 is inverted

    # temporarily flip negated variables
    for i, n in zip(indices, negated):
        if n:
            qc.x(problem_qubits[i])

    qc.ccx(problem_qubits[indices[0]], problem_qubits[indices[1]], scratch[0])

    qc.ccx(problem_qubits[indices[0]], problem_qubits[indices[1]], scratch[0])

    # restore negated variables
    for i, n in zip(indices, negated):
        if n:
            qc.x(problem_qubits[i])

# Grover phase oracle fragments for 3-SAT clauses.
# Each fragment flips `flag` iff the corresponding clause is satisfied.
# Temporary scratch qubits (list of 2) are returned to |0⟩.

def build_constraint_1(qc, problem_qubits, flag, scratch):
    # clause: (NOT x0 OR x1 OR NOT x3)
    q0 = problem_qubits[0]   # ¬x0 → keep as is
    q1 = problem_qubits[1]   # x1  → flip to get ¬x1
    q2 = problem_qubits[3]   # ¬x3 → keep as is
    # flip to obtain false‑condition bits (1 when literal false)
    qc.x(q1)
    # compute AND of false bits: q0 ∧ ¬q1 ∧ q2
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, scratch[0])
    qc.ccx(scratch[0], q2, scratch[1])
    # flip flag when AND = 0 (i.e., clause satisfied)
    qc.x(scratch[1])
    qc.cx(scratch[1], flag)
    qc.x(scratch[1])
    # uncompute AND
    qc.ccx(scratch[0], q2, scratch[1])
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, scratch[0])
    # restore qubit flips
    qc.x(q1)

def build_constraint_2(qc, problem_qubits, flag, scratch):
    # clause: (NOT x0 OR x2 OR x3)
    q0 = problem_qubits[0]   # ¬x0 → keep
    q2 = problem_qubits[2]   # x2  → flip
    q3 = problem_qubits[3]   # x3  → flip
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.x(q3)
    # compute AND of false bits: q0 ∧ ¬q2 ∧ ¬q3
    qc.ccx(q0, q2, scratch[0])
    qc.ccx(scratch[0], q3, scratch[1])
    qc.x(scratch[1])
    qc.cx(scratch[1], flag)
    qc.x(scratch[1])
    qc.ccx(scratch[0], q3, scratch[1])

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
import math
import numpy as np

def _edge_differs(qc, problem_qubits, flag, scratch, u, v):
    """
    Helper: flip flag if the decoded colors of vertices u and v are different.
    Uses scratch[0], scratch[1] as temporary storage.
    """
    # Vertex bits
    b0_u = problem_qubits[2*u]
    b1_u = problem_qubits[2*u+1]
    b0_v = problem_qubits[2*v]
    b1_v = problem_qubits[2*v+1]
    s0 = scratch[0]  # holds d0 = 1 iff vertex u is color 2
    s1 = scratch[1]  # holds d1 = 1 iff vertex u is color 1

    # ---- Compute canonical representation for vertex u ----
    # s0 = (b1_u == 1 and b0_u == 0)  (color 2)
    qc.x(b0_u)
    qc.ccx(b1_u, b0_u, s0)
    qc.x(b0_u)

    # s1 = (b1_u == 0 and b0_u == 1)  (color 1)
    qc.x(b1_u)
    qc.ccx(b1_u, b0_u, s1)
    qc.x(b1_u)

    # ---- Now compare vertex v to the stored canonical ----
    # The canonical (d0,d1) equals (0,0) -> vertex u is color 0
    #   then vertex v is same color iff (b0_v,b1_v) in {(0,0),(1,1)}
    # Pattern (0,0): (b0_v=0, b1_v=0, s0=0, s1=0)
    qc.x(b0_v); qc.x(b1_v); qc.x(s0); qc.x(s1)
    qc.mcx([b0_v, b1_v, s0, s1], flag, mode='noancilla')
    qc.x(b0_v); qc.x(b1_v); qc.x(s0); qc.x(s1)

    # Pattern (1,1): (b0_v=1, b1_v=1, s0=0, s1=0)
    qc.x(s0); qc.x(s1)
    qc.mcx([b0_v, b1_v, s0, s1], flag, mode='noancilla')
    qc.x(s0); qc.x(s1)

    # Canonical (0,1) -> vertex u is color 1
    #   vertex v matches iff (b0_v=1, b1_v=0, s0=0, s1=1)
    qc.x(b1_v); qc.x(s0)
    qc.mcx([b0_v, b1_v, s0, s1], flag, mode='noancilla')
    qc.x(b1_v); qc.x(s0)

    # Canonical (1,0) -> vertex u is color 2
    #   vertex v matches iff (b0_v=0, b1_v=1, s0=1, s1=0)
    qc.x(b0_v); qc.x(s1)
    qc.mcx([b0_v, b1_v, s0, s1], flag, mode='noancilla')
    qc.x(b0_v); qc.x(s1)

    # ---- Uncompute scratch ----
    # Undo s1
    qc.x(b1_u)
    qc.ccx(b1_u, b0_u, s1)
    qc.x(b1_u)

    # Undo s0
    qc.x(b0_u)
    qc.ccx(b1_u, b0_u, s0)
    qc.x(b0_u)

def build_constraint_1(qc, problem_qubits, flag, scratch):
    # edge (0,1): vertices 0 (qubits 0,1) and 1 (qubits 2,3)
    a0 = problem_qubits[0]
    a1 = problem_qubits[1]
    b0 = problem_qubits[2]
    b1 = problem_qubits[3]
    s = scratch[0]               # the single scratch qubit

    # --- compute p = a0 xor a1, store on a0 ---
    qc.cx(a1, a0)                # a0 -> p

    # --- compute q = b0 xor b1, store on b0 ---
    qc.cx(b1, b0)                # b0 -> q

    # --- compute r = a0 xor b0, store on a1 (original a1 is overwritten) ---
    qc.cx(a0, a1)                # a1 becomes a1 xor p
    qc.cx(b0, a1)                # a1 becomes a1 xor p xor q
    qc.cx(b1, a1)                # a1 becomes a1 xor p xor q xor b1 = r

    # --- term2 = p & q & r, XOR it onto flag ---
    qc.ccx(a0, b0, s)            # s = p & q
    qc.ccx(s, a1, flag)          # flag ^= p & q & r
    qc.ccx(a0, b0, s)            # s -> 0

    # --- restore problem qubits ---
    qc.cx(a0, a1)                # restore a1 (first step)
    qc.cx(b0, a1)                # restore a1 (second)
    qc.cx(b1, a1)                # restore a1 (third) – a1 now back to original
    qc.cx(a1, a0)                # restore a0
    qc.cx(b1, b0)                # restore b0

    # --- term1 = p xor q = a0 xor a1 xor b0 xor b1, store on s ---
    qc.cx(a0, s)                 # s = a0
    qc.cx(a1, s)                 # s = a0 xor a1
    qc.cx(b0, s)                 # s = a0 xor a1 xor b0
    qc.cx(b1, s)                 # s = a0 xor a1 xor b0 xor b1

    # --- final XOR of term1 onto flag ---
    qc.cx(s, flag)

    # --- uncompute s ---
    qc.cx(b1, s)                 # start undoing
    qc.cx(b0, s)
    qc.cx(a1, s)
    qc.cx(a0, s)                 # s back to 0

    a0, a1 = problem_qubits[0], problem_qubits[1]

    patterns = [

        [1,1,0,0],  # (11,00)
        [1,1,1,1],  # (11,11)
        [1,0,1,0],  # (01,01)
        [0,1,0,1],  # (10,10)

    # flip flag for each pattern (to get equality)
    for pat in patterns:

        for i, invert in enumerate(pat):

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Constraint 1: cells (0,0) != (0,1)  (i.e., decoded values differ)
# Uses scratch[0], scratch[1], scratch[2]
# ------------------------------------------------------------
def build_constraint_1(qc, problem_qubits, flag, scratch):
    q0, q1 = problem_qubits[0], problem_qubits[1]   # cell0
    q2, q3 = problem_qubits[2], problem_qubits[3]   # cell1
    fl = flag
    s0, s1, s2 = scratch[0], scratch[1], scratch[2]

    # ---------- forward: compute equality s0 = (value0 == value1) ----------
    # Case 1: value0 equality (both a0==a1 and b0==b1)
    # s1 = a0==a1 = NOT(a0 XOR a1)
    qc.cx(q0, s1)
    qc.cx(q1, s1)
    qc.x(s1)
    # s2 = b0==b1
    qc.cx(q2, s2)
    qc.cx(q3, s2)
    qc.x(s2)
    qc.ccx(s1, s2, s0)
    # uncompute s1,s2
    qc.x(s1)
    qc.cx(q1, s1)
    qc.cx(q0, s1)
    qc.x(s2)
    qc.cx(q3, s2)
    qc.cx(q2, s2)

    # Case 2: value1 equality (a0=1,a1=0,b0=1,b1=0)
    # s1 = a0 AND NOT a1
    qc.x(q1)
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, s1)
    qc.x(q1)
    # s2 = b0 AND NOT b1
    qc.x(q3)
    qc.ccx(q2, q3, s2)
    qc.x(q3)
    qc.ccx(s1, s2, s0)
    # uncompute s1,s2
    qc.x(q3)
    qc.ccx(q2, q3, s2)
    qc.x(q3)
    qc.x(q1)
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, s1)
    qc.x(q1)

    # Case 3: value2 equality (a0=0,a1=1,b0=0,b1=1)
    # s1 = NOT a0 AND a1
    qc.x(q0)
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, s1)
    qc.x(q0)
    # s2 = NOT b0 AND b1
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.ccx(q2, q3, s2)
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.ccx(s1, s2, s0)
    # uncompute s1,s2
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.ccx(q2, q3, s2)
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.x(q0)
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, s1)
    qc.x(q0)

    # ---------- use equality flag to flip flag when unequal ----------
    qc.cx(s0, fl)   # flip if equal
    qc.x(fl)        # invert -> flips when not equal

    # ---------- uncompute s0 by repeating the three cases ----------
    # Case 1 again
    qc.cx(q0, s1)
    qc.cx(q1, s1)
    qc.x(s1)
    qc.cx(q2, s2)
    qc.cx(q3, s2)
    qc.x(s2)
    qc.ccx(s1, s2, s0)
    qc.x(s1)
    qc.cx(q1, s1)
    qc.cx(q0, s1)
    qc.x(s2)
    qc.cx(q3, s2)
    qc.cx(q2, s2)

    qc.x(q1)
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, s1)
    qc.x(q1)
    qc.x(q3)
    qc.ccx(q2, q3, s2)
    qc.x(q3)
    qc.ccx(s1, s2, s0)
    qc.x(q3)
    qc.ccx(q2, q3, s2)
    qc.x(q3)
    qc.x(q1)
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, s1)
    qc.x(q1)

    qc.ccx(q0, q1, s1)
    qc.x(q0)
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.ccx(q2, q3, s2)
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.ccx(s1, s2, s0)
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.ccx(q2, q3, s2)
    qc.x(q2)
    qc.x(q0)
    qc.ccx(q0, q1, s1)
    qc.x(q0)

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def _cell_neq_given(qc, a, b, d, flag, scr):
    """
    Helper: flips `flag` if the cell (a,b) decodes to a value != d.
    scr is a single scratch qubit (index 0 of the `scratch` list provided).
    """
    if d == 0:
        # cell == 0 iff a == b
        # flip flag if a != b  (i.e. a XOR b)
        qc.cx(a, scr[0])
        qc.cx(b, scr[0])
        # now scr[0] = a XOR b = 1 iff cell != 0
        qc.cx(scr[0], flag)
        # uncompute
        qc.cx(b, scr[0])
        qc.cx(a, scr[0])
    elif d == 1:
        # cell == 1 iff (a=1, b=0)
        qc.x(b)
        qc.ccx(a, b, scr[0])
        qc.x(b)
        # scr = 1 iff cell == 1
        qc.x(scr[0])
        qc.cx(scr[0], flag)
        qc.x(scr[0])
        # uncompute
        qc.x(b)
        qc.ccx(a, b, scr[0])
        qc.x(b)
    elif d == 2:
        # cell == 2 iff (a=0, b=1)
        qc.x(a)
        qc.ccx(a, b, scr[0])
        qc.x(a)
        # scr = 1 iff cell == 2
        qc.x(scr[0])
        qc.cx(scr[0], flag)
        qc.x(scr[0])
        # uncompute
        qc.x(a)
        qc.ccx(a, b, scr[0])
        qc.x(a)
    else:
        raise ValueError("d must be 0, 1, or 2")

def _cells_neq(qc, bits1, bits2, flag, scratch):
    """
    Helper for constraint 8: flips `flag` if the two cells (each a pair of qubits)
    decode to different values.
    bits1 = [a, b] for cell0, bits2 = [c, d] for cell2.
    Uses scratch[0..6] (7 qubits).
    """
    a, b = bits1
    c, d = bits2
    # Normalize each cell to a two‑bit representation
    # x = a AND NOT b, y = b AND NOT a   (00 and 11 both map to 00)
    # x, y will be stored in scratch[0], scratch[1] for cell0
    # and scratch[2], scratch[3] for cell2.
    # Compute x0 = a & ~b
    qc.x(b)
    qc.ccx(a, b, scratch[0])
    qc.x(b)
    # Compute y0 = b & ~a
    qc.x(a)
    qc.ccx(b, a, scratch[1])
    qc.x(a)
    # Compute x2 = c & ~d
    qc.x(d)
    qc.ccx(c, d, scratch[2])
    qc.x(d)
    # Compute y2 = d & ~c
    qc.x(c)
    qc.ccx(d, c, scratch[3])
    qc.x(c)
    # Now compute equality on the normalized bits
    # eq_x = NOT (x0 XOR x2)
    qc.cx(scratch[0], scratch[4])
    qc.cx(scratch[2], scratch[4])
    qc.x(scratch[4])
    # eq_y = NOT (y0 XOR y2)
    qc.cx(scratch[1], scratch[5])
    qc.cx(scratch[3], scratch[5])
    qc.x(scratch[5])
    # equal = eq_x AND eq_y
    qc.ccx(scratch[4], scratch[5], scratch[6])
    # Flip flag if not equal
    qc.x(scratch[6])
    qc.cx(scratch[6], flag)
    qc.x(scratch[6])
    # Uncompute equal
    qc.ccx(scratch[4], scratch[5], scratch[6])
    # Uncompute eq_y
    qc.x(scratch[5])
    qc.cx(scratch[1], scratch[5])
    qc.cx(scratch[3], scratch[5])
    # Uncompute eq_x
    qc.x(scratch[4])
    qc.cx(scratch[0], scratch[4])
    qc.cx(scratch[2], scratch[4])
    # Uncompute normalized bits (each is self‑inverse)
    qc.x(c)
    qc.ccx(d, c, scratch[3])
    qc.x(c)
    qc.x(d)
    qc.ccx(c, d, scratch[2])
    qc.x(d)
    qc.x(a)
    qc.ccx(b, a, scratch[1])
    qc.x(a)
    qc.x(b)
    qc.ccx(a, b, scratch[0])
    qc.x(b)

    for q, bit in zip(controls, pattern):

    qc.mcx(controls, target, mode='noancilla')
